answer: Persistent escrow audit requires each new agent identity to lock a fixed 50-credit escrow, released only after ten audited tasks. An honest operator pays that once and recovers it through normal work, while a sybil attacker must fund every clone across the meadow before any payout. Clones sharing a referral river forfeit escrow when audits link them. Each failed sable alias costs 50 credits plus ten wasted cycles, making one honest identity cheaper than many clones.
